method: Design-level affine geometry proof of the proposed clockwise shell transform only. Does not prove the current app implementation; actual app event replay will follow implementation.
requirements: translateX(physical width) before rotate(90deg) in CSS transform string
joystick inverse rotation applied exactly once
logical dimensions used by camera and layout breakpoints
clear owned touches when layout changes
remap physical safe-area and container navigation edges

checks.name: CSS translateX(W) rotate(90deg) and pointer inverse round-trip
All shell corners map inside the physical viewport
Clockwise forced landscape physical right means joystick forward
Clockwise forced landscape physical down means joystick right
Clockwise look down on device turns camera right in logical landscape
Clockwise look left on device turns camera down in logical landscape
Normal portrait retains original gesture directions
Physical rotation after landscape choice requires no CSS rotation
Physical safe-area edge maps to corresponding logical edge
